title: Setup
note: Module 00 has no verifier script — its checkpoint is five shell commands. Each is written to succeed or fail on its exit code so the result is not a judgement call. Run with the venv active.

checks.label: Python is 3.11 or newer
checks.command: python -c "import sys; assert sys.version_info >= (3, 11), sys.version; print(sys.version.split()[0])"

checks.label: core packages import
checks.on_failure: If this fails but the Python version check passed, the venv is not active in this shell. Activation is per-shell. Run `which python` — if it is not inside .venv, that is the answer. Bash on Windows: `source .venv/Scripts/activate` (Scripts, not bin; the extensionless activate, not Activate.ps1).

checks.label: working on a learner branch, not main
checks.on_failure: You are on main. Workshop content lives on main; your build belongs on your own branch. See workshop/00-setup.md section 5.

optional.label: claude_agent_sdk imports (needed for module 04, not for 01)
